nodes.name: computed_value_flags.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ComputedValueFlags bitflags struct used to track misc information about a given computed style, including flags for text decoration, line breaks, viewport units, container queries, and font metrics dependencies.

nodes.name: gecko.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Mako template generating Gecko-specific ComputedValues implementations, including FFI bindings for constructing, copying, and destroying style structs between Rust and C++.
nodes.languageNotes: Mako template that generates Rust code with Gecko FFI bindings for Servo's style system integration with Firefox.

nodes.name: helpers.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Mako template providing helper macros and functions used across property definitions, including property longhand code generation templates and shared parsing/serialization logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Mako template with <%def> blocks that generate repetitive Rust property code.

nodes.name: animated_properties.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Mako template generating the AnimationValue enum and related animation logic for CSS property interpolation, including support for squaring distance computation and zero-value generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates AnimationValue enum variants for all animatable CSS longhands using Mako iteration.

nodes.name: properties.html.mako
nodes.summary: Mako template that generates an HTML page listing all supported CSS properties in Servo, organized by longhands and shorthands with their feature preferences.

nodes.name: properties.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Main Mako template that generates the core CSS property system code, including style struct definitions, property declaration handling, cascade logic, and FFI types for both Servo and Gecko engines.
nodes.languageNotes: The central Mako template that drives the entire property code generation pipeline, importing helpers and iterating over all property definitions from data.py.

nodes.name: mako-1.3.10-py3-none-any.whl
nodes.summary: Vendored Mako template engine Python wheel used by the build system to render .mako.rs templates into Rust source files during compilation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Vendored MarkupSafe library providing HTML escaping utilities, including the Markup string class and escape/escape_silent functions used by the Mako template engine.

nodes.name: LICENSE.txt
nodes.summary: BSD 3-Clause license for the vendored MarkupSafe library from the Pallets project.

nodes.name: toml-0.10.2-py2.py3-none-any.whl
nodes.summary: Vendored TOML parser Python wheel used by the build system to read configuration files like longhands.toml.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Overview documentation for the Servo style system crate, with a link to the architecture documentation.

nodes.name: box.rs
nodes.summary: Defines computed value types for CSS box properties including BaselineShift, OverflowClipMargin, ContainIntrinsicSize, LineClamp, Perspective, Resize, and Zoom, with animation and serialization support.

nodes.name: box.rs
nodes.summary: Defines generic type parameters for box-related CSS properties including BaselineShift, ContainIntrinsicSize, LineClamp, Perspective, OverflowClipMargin, and PositionProperty, enabling code reuse across specified and computed value layers.

nodes.name: box.rs
nodes.summary: Defines specified value types for all box-related CSS properties including Display, Overflow, Position, Contain, ContainerQueries, ScrollSnap, and appearance-related types with parsing and serialization logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavily uses derive macros and the Servo styling system's type infrastructure for automatic ToCss, Parse, and ToComputedValue implementations.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Build script for the stylo_atoms crate that generates Rust atom type definitions from static_atoms.txt and predefined counter style names using string_cache_codegen.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo package configuration for stylo_atoms crate defining dependencies on string_cache and string_cache_codegen for generating interned string types.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Library entry point for stylo_atoms that includes the generated atom.rs file produced by the build script at compile time.

nodes.name: predefined_counter_styles.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the list of predefined CSS counter style names (decimal, roman, georgian, etc.) used by the atom generation build script, duplicated from style/counter_style/predefined.rs.

nodes.name: static_atoms.txt
nodes.summary: List of static atom string constants used by the atom generation build script to produce the interned string type for Servo's style system.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo package configuration for stylo_dom crate defining dependencies on bitflags and malloc_size_of for DOM state type definitions shared between Rust and C++.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ElementState and DocumentState bitflags types shared between Rust and C++ for tracking interactive element states (focus, hover, active, disabled, etc.) and document-level activation states.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Build script for stylo_static_prefs that reads preferences.toml and generates Rust code with static AtomicBool and AtomicI32 arrays, plus pref! and set_pref! macros for runtime preference access.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo package configuration for stylo_static_prefs crate with a build dependency on the TOML parser for reading preference definitions.

nodes.name: preferences.toml
nodes.summary: Static preferences configuration file defining boolean and integer preference defaults for layout features, CSS properties, and rendering options in the Servo style system.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Runtime library for stylo_static_prefs that includes generated preference code and provides a test verifying basic get/set preference functionality.

nodes.name: ComputedValueFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags struct tracking misc computed style metadata including text decoration lines, viewport units, container queries, font metrics dependencies, and author-specified property flags.

nodes.name: ComputedValues
nodes.summary: Core computed style storage structure with Gecko FFI bindings, providing construction, cloning, pseudo-element handling, style struct management, and integration with Firefox's style system.

nodes.name: clone_with_flags
nodes.summary: Creates a new ComputedValues clone with modified flags and optional pseudo-element override, preserving style structs and custom properties.

nodes.name: ineffective_content_property
nodes.summary: Indicates whether the content property on this style has no effect, used by Gecko layout optimizations.

nodes.name: visited_style
nodes.summary: Returns the visited style for this computed values, used by Gecko to handle :visited pseudo-class styling.

nodes.name: set_
nodes.summary: Sets a style struct value in the ComputedValues inner storage by index.

nodes.name: reset_
nodes.summary: Resets a style struct by copying from another ComputedValuesInner instance, used for style struct inheritance.

nodes.name: from_iter
nodes.summary: Generates FromIterator implementation for vector-valued CSS properties, collecting parsed items into the appropriate container type.

nodes.name: AnimationValue
nodes.summary: Enum representing a single computed value from an animated CSS property, supporting interpolation, squared distance computation, and zero-value generation for transitions and animations.

nodes.name: MaybeBoxed
nodes.summary: Trait for converting between boxed and unboxed representations of property values, with implementations for both T and Box<T>.

nodes.name: PrioritaryPropertyId
nodes.summary: Enum of CSS property IDs that require special cascade priority handling during style computation.

nodes.name: AliasId
nodes.summary: Enum of CSS property alias IDs mapping vendor-prefixed and legacy property names to their canonical property identifiers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new empty LonghandIdSet for tracking which CSS longhand properties have been set.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given property group ID is contained in a PrioritaryPropertyId set.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a property group into a PrioritaryPropertyId set for cascade priority tracking.

nodes.name: Markup
nodes.summary: String subclass representing HTML-safe text, with methods for string manipulation that preserve the safe markup status and an escape class method for creating safe strings from raw text.

nodes.name: escape
nodes.summary: Replaces HTML special characters (&, <, >, ', ") with their escape sequences, returning a Markup object. Respects __html__ protocol for objects that self-represent as safe HTML.

nodes.name: escape_silent
nodes.summary: Like escape but returns an empty Markup string when the input is None, useful for optional values.

nodes.name: soft_str
nodes.summary: Converts an object to string while preserving Markup type, preventing double-escaping of already-safe strings.

nodes.name: Zoom
nodes.summary: Computed value type for the CSS zoom property, supporting zoom factor storage, CSS serialization, animation, and effective zoom computation relative to a parent or document zoom level.

nodes.name: GenericBaselineShift
nodes.summary: Generic enum for the CSS baseline-shift property, supporting keyword values (sub, super, top, center, bottom) or a length/percentage offset.

nodes.name: GenericContainIntrinsicSize
nodes.summary: Generic enum for the CSS contain-intrinsic-size property, supporting none, auto-none, a length, or auto-length variants.

nodes.name: GenericLineClamp
nodes.summary: Generic enum for the CSS -webkit-line-clamp property, supporting none or an integer count of lines to clamp.

nodes.name: GenericPerspective
nodes.summary: Generic enum for the CSS perspective property, supporting none or a non-negative length value for 3D transform perspective.

nodes.name: PositionProperty
nodes.summary: Generic enum for the CSS position property with static, relative, absolute, sticky, and fixed variants, including a helper to check if the value yields absolutely positioned elements.

nodes.name: GenericOverflowClipMargin
nodes.summary: Generic struct for the CSS overflow-clip-margin property, combining a visual box reference box and a length offset.

nodes.name: DisplayOutside
nodes.summary: Enum representing the outer display type (none, inline, block, table-caption, internal-table, internal-ruby) for the CSS display property.

nodes.name: DisplayInside
nodes.summary: Enum representing the inner display type (flow, flow-root, table, flex, grid, ruby, etc.) with validation for list-item compatibility.

nodes.name: Display
nodes.summary: Core specified value type for the CSS display property, combining outside and inside display types with list-item flag, providing parsing, serialization, and layout query methods.

nodes.name: DominantBaseline
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS dominant-baseline property (auto, use-script, no-change, reset-size, ideographic, alphabetic, hanging, mathematical, central, middle, text-after-edge, text-before-edge).

nodes.name: AlignmentBaseline
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS alignment-baseline property (baseline, text-bottom, alphabetic, ideographic, middle, central, mathematical, text-top, bottom, center, top).

nodes.name: ScrollSnapType
nodes.summary: Specified value for the CSS scroll-snap-type property, combining a snap axis and strictness for scroll container snap behavior.

nodes.name: ScrollSnapAlign
nodes.summary: Specified value for the CSS scroll-snap-align property, defining block and inline alignment of snap positions.

nodes.name: Contain
nodes.summary: Bitflags type for the CSS contain property, controlling size, layout, style, paint containment and content visibility optimizations.

nodes.name: ContainerType
nodes.summary: Bitflags type for the CSS container-type property, defining size and inline-size containment for container queries.

nodes.name: ContainerName
nodes.summary: Specified value for the CSS container-name property, supporting none or a list of custom container query names.

nodes.name: Float
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS float property (none, left, right) with a helper to check if the element is floating.

nodes.name: Clear
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS clear property (none, left, right, both, inline-start, inline-end) controlling element clearance after floats.

nodes.name: Resize
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS resize property (none, both, horizontal, vertical, block, inline) controlling element resizability.

nodes.name: Appearance
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS appearance property with extensive Gecko-specific keyword support for native widget styling (button, textfield, menulist, scrollbar, etc.).

nodes.name: Overflow
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSS overflow property keyword values (visible, hidden, clip, scroll, auto) with scrollability detection.

nodes.name: Zoom
nodes.summary: Specified value type for the CSS zoom property, wrapping a number or the normal keyword.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point for the stylo_atoms build script: reads static_atoms.txt and predefined counter style names, generates an AtomType with string_cache_codegen, and writes the atom.rs output file.

nodes.name: ElementState
nodes.summary: Bitflags type defining 50+ interactive element states (focus, hover, active, disabled, checked, visited, etc.) for CSS selector matching, shared between Rust and C++ via repr(C).

nodes.name: DocumentState
nodes.summary: Bitflags type for document-level states such as window activation and locale direction (RTL/LTR), shared between Rust and C++.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point for the stylo_static_prefs build script that triggers recompilation when preferences.toml changes and generates preference access code.

nodes.name: parse_preferences
nodes.summary: Reads and parses preferences.toml into separate lists of boolean and integer preferences with their default values.

nodes.name: generate_code
nodes.summary: Generates Rust source code with static AtomicBool/AtomicI32 arrays and pref!/set_pref! macros from parsed preference definitions, writing the output to a generated.rs file.

nodes.name: test_basic_preferences
nodes.summary: Test function that verifies basic preference get/set functionality using the pref! and set_pref! macros.
